name: Viola Instrument Pack
description: Practice naming notes on the viola fingerboard and identifying the parts of the instrument. Two lessons and 49 bowed viola recordings let you hear each semitone from C3 to C7.

name: Harpsichord Instrument Pack
description: Train your ear and your eye on a Flemish double harpsichord: name the interval between two highlighted keys, name the instrument's parts, and work through two lessons with glossary entries.
